refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute the spectral density estimator using a data vector.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: sde = spectral_xdf(x) sde = spectral_xdf(x, win) sde = spectral_xdf(x, win, b)

listitem.para: (optional) The window name. Default is "triangle". Supported values are "triangle" and "rectangle".

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `spectral_xdf` function computes the spectral density estimator given a data vector `x`, a window name `win`, and a bandwidth `b`. The window name is used to search for a function called `win_sw` (e.g., "triangle" or "rectangle"). If `win` is omitted, the triangle window is used. If `b` is omitted, 1 / sqrt(length(x)) is used.
